Callout.Name: Fire Lookout Report
Callout.Message: Smoke reported from a fire lookout tower.
Callout.Advisory: Smoke to the east, no access road.

Script.Line: Smoke, three ridges over, and it is not camp smoke.
I have it from the tower and it is building.
If it gets over that ridge there is nothing to stop it.

Lines.Approach: The lookout has smoke to the east and no road within a mile of it. That is the start of something.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
